```yaml
name: Test FATFS support

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  test-fatfs:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y build-essential cmake git dosfstools openssh-server

      - name: Build wolfSSH and wolfSFTP
        run: |
          make -j$(nproc)
          chmod +x wolfSFTP

      - name: Create FATFS image
        run: |
          dd if=/dev/zero of=fatfs.img bs=1M count=1
          mkfs.fat -F 32 fatfs.img

      - name: Mount FATFS image
        run: |
          sudo mkdir -p /mnt/fatfs
          sudo mount -t vfat -o loop,uid=$(id -u),gid=$(id -g) fatfs.img /mnt/fatfs

      - name: Setup SFTP server
        run: |
          sudo useradd -m sftpuser
          echo "sftpuser:password" | sudo chpasswd
          sudo mkdir -p /home/sftpuser/.ssh
          sudo chown -R sftpuser:sftpuser /home/sftpuser
          echo "Hello FATFS" > /home/sftpuser/test.txt
          cat <<EOF | sudo tee /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/99-sftp.conf
          Port 2222
          ListenAddress 127.0.0.1
          PermitRootLogin no
          PasswordAuthentication yes
          ChallengeResponseAuthentication no
          UsePAM no
          Subsystem sftp internal-sftp
          EOF
          sudo systemctl restart sshd

      - name: Wait for SSH to start
        run: sleep 5

      - name: Compute original file hash
        id: hash
        run: |
          echo "orig_hash=$(sha256sum /home/sftpuser/test.txt | awk '{print $1}')" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Run wolfsftp client to download file
        run: |
          ./wolfSFTP -s localhost:2222 -u sftpuser -p password -l /mnt/fatfs -r /test.txt

      - name: Verify downloaded file exists
        run: |
          if [ ! -f /mnt/fatfs/test.txt ]; then
            echo "Downloaded file not found"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Verify file contents
        run: |
          download_hash=$(sha256sum /mnt/fatfs/test.txt | awk '{print $1}')
          if [ "$download_hash" != "$orig_hash" ]; then
            echo "File contents do not match"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Cleanup
        if: always()
        run: |
          sudo umount /mnt/fatfs
          sudo rm -rf /mnt/fatfs fatfs.img
          sudo systemctl stop sshd
```
